_about: Events behind /events/. Rule: no event is published without a credible, named source. verificationStatus 'verified' needs sourceUrl + lastVerified and is the only state that produces Event structured data; 'reported' is shown with a visible 'awaiting official confirmation' flag and produces no structured data. price: null means not confirmed (never assume free).

events.title: Simhastha Kumbh Mela opens: Dhwajarohan (flag-hoisting)
events.location: Ramtirth (Ramkund), Nashik and Kushavarta Tirth, Trimbakeshwar
events.description: The Authority's official FAQ gives the Dhwajarohan (flag-hoisting) as 31 October 2026 at 12:02 PM. Press reports describe simultaneous ceremonies at Ramkund and Kushavarta Tirtha.
events.sourceName: Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Kumbh Mela Authority: official FAQ (page last updated 17 Nov 2026)

events.title: First Amrut Snan
events.description: First of the three main Amrut Snan dates (Somvati Amavasya), as given in the Authority's official FAQ. Akhara procession timings and public bathing arrangements have not been announced.
events.sourceName: Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Kumbh Mela Authority: official FAQ (page last updated 17 Nov 2026)

events.title: Second Amrut Snan
events.description: Second Amrut Snan (Shravan Amavasya), as given in the Authority's official FAQ. Arrangements have not been announced.
events.sourceName: Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Kumbh Mela Authority: official FAQ (page last updated 17 Nov 2026)

events.title: Third Amrut Snan — Nashik
events.description: Third Amrut Snan at Ramtirth (Ramkund), Nashik, as given in the Authority's official FAQ. Press reports describe it as the Vaishnava akharas' snan. Arrangements have not been announced.
events.sourceName: Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Kumbh Mela Authority: official FAQ (page last updated 17 Nov 2026)

events.title: Third Amrut Snan — Trimbakeshwar
events.description: Third Amrut Snan at Kushavarta Tirth, Trimbakeshwar, as given in the Authority's official FAQ. Press reports describe it as the Shaiva akharas' snan. Arrangements have not been announced.
events.sourceName: Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Kumbh Mela Authority: official FAQ (page last updated 17 Nov 2026)

events.title: Simhastha Kumbh Mela concludes: Dhwajavatarana (flag-lowering)
events.location: Ramkund, Nashik and Kushavarta Tirtha, Trimbakeshwar
events.description: The Authority's official FAQ gives the Dhwajavatarana (flag-lowering) as 24 July 2028 at 3:36 PM.
events.sourceName: Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Kumbh Mela Authority: official FAQ (page last updated 17 Nov 2026)
